_counts_convention: RAW BRAKET, confirmed by DCV Worker 2026-08-31 via the exact call chain AwsQuantumTask(arn).result().measurement_counts -- NO qiskit_braket_provider anywhere in the path, so the string has NOT been character-reversed. Braket convention: leftmost character = LOWEST measured-qubit index. With measured_qubits=[3,4,5,6,7,8]: char 0 = q3. This matters because qiskit_braket_provider reverses the string character-for-character; decoding raw-Braket counts under the provider convention would silently invert every (m1,m2) pair. Cf. CLAUDE.md known-bug item 4.
_measured_qubit_layout: 9 qubits: q0-q2 target (unmeasured), q3-q5 precision stage 1 (-> c[0..2], m1), q6-q8 precision stage 2 (-> c[3..5], m2), per build_full_circuit in submit_QPUF_ntarg.py. Combined with the raw-Braket convention above: chars 0-2 = m1, chars 3-5 = m2. Within each 3-bit group prec[0] is the MOST significant bit of that stage's integer, because build_qpe_stage assigns qubit k the controlled power U^(2^(n_prec-1-k)) (MSB-first) and applies the inverse QFT to prec[::-1].
